name: nixploy-migrate-deps
description: Dependencies for docker/migrate.mjs — the migration runner the image entrypoint executes before the panel starts. Deliberately separate from the workspace node_modules so a migration can run on a half-built tree. Versions are pinned exactly to what packages/server resolves in pnpm-lock.yaml; package-lock.json pins the transitive tree too (security.md §2.8).
